turns.speaker: Steve
turns.text: Ah, so you think you should already know all about emotional labor and boundary-setting, huh? Well, let’s refresh your memory then. Emotional labor is like being a professional emotion detector and dispenser. You gotta keep a smile on your face even when you’re having a bad day. But here’s the thing—setting boundaries is like putting up a fence around your emotional space. It’s perfectly okay to acknowledge John’s personal questions with something like, “Thanks for sharing that; I value our friendship, but I need some personal space right now.” Keep it short and sweet, and remember, it’s not about being mean, just about managing your own feelings.
